title: Chorus Jig
author: Chestnut
problems: The progression after row 4 "ones up the center and cast around same-role neighbors - note next neighbors below · cast" doesn't work out: Couples 3 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
Row 5 "ones contra corners" can't start from where the dancers are: The 1s must stand across from each other to start contra corners.
Row 6 "partners balance & swing, end facing up the hall (away from new neighbors) · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
The progression after row 4 "ones up the center and cast around same-role neighbors - note next neighbors below · cast" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
